main_measure.name: mean unusual 5-bar move of short cases, short-signed (signal-bar return minus coin's normal 5-bar drift)

statistic.name: t of the mean, cases summed per day

main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2 and supporting check passed; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; minimum 30 distinct case days

supporting_check.name: mean unusual move of larger-|forecast| half minus smaller half, > 0

decided_by: mean unusual move positive with t >= 2 and the larger-|forecast| half beating the smaller half: the confirm rule.
reading: situation recomputed from prices (fall5's recorded value fills the 5-day return at window starts); a case is the first short bet (rise of |forecast| on the short side of >= 2 from its lowest level since the last bet, reset on flat/long) in each 5-bar grid cell from each window's first row; t clusters cases by UTC day of the signal bar; the larger half is |forecast| strictly above the median, the smaller half at or below it; the 30-day minimum, per the workflow, gives 'not observable'.

direction_check.why: main measure +0.01044 on the check folds against +0.02238 on every fold
